name: Customer Feedback Calls
h1: Collect Customer Feedback by Phone With a Voice Agent
metaDescription: Call customers after a visit or delivery, ask your questions, and get structured answers plus call summaries back in your CRM or inbox.
intro: Surveys sent by email are answered by the people who are very pleased or very angry, and by few others. A short phone call after a visit reaches a wider slice of customers, because many people will talk for a minute who would never open a form. The obstacle is effort: someone has to place dozens of calls, take notes in a consistent way and tabulate the notes. A Calldesk feedback agent handles that routine. You supply a list of recent customers as a CSV, with a phone number and columns such as first name, service date and technician, and create a batch call. The agent introduces itself as an AI assistant calling on behalf of your business, asks for a minute, and runs through your questions in a conversational way. Answers are saved into named fields, for example a rating out of five, a free-text comment and whether the person would like a follow-up. Unhappy customers can be offered a transfer to a manager or a callback, which turns a complaint into a chance to fix the problem. The summaries and fields come out through the dashboard, API or webhooks, ready for your reporting tool.
steps: Decide on three to five questions, including one rating question and one open question, and a threshold below which the customer is offered a follow-up.
Create an agent from the win-back-campaign or outreach-dialer template and rewrite it as a feedback call, with an opening that names your business and says it is an AI assistant.
Define extraction fields such as rating, comment, would_recommend and wants_follow_up so every call produces comparable data.
Add a branch for low ratings that offers a transfer to a manager, or takes a callback time, and a short thank-you close for everyone else.
Prepare a CSV with a phone column and variable columns such as first_name and service_date, create a batch call, and set a call time window in the customers' time zone.
Run a small first batch, listen to or read the transcripts, and refine the questions before sending the full list.
Send call-completed events to a webhook, or read the call list, so ratings and comments flow into your reporting.

sampleCallFlow.speaker: agent
sampleCallFlow.text: Hi, is this Maya? This is an AI assistant calling for Cedar Lane Vet about Poppy's visit on Tuesday. Do you have a minute for two quick questions?

sampleCallFlow.speaker: agent
sampleCallFlow.text: Thanks. On a scale of one to five, how would you rate your visit?

sampleCallFlow.speaker: agent
sampleCallFlow.text: Thank you for being honest. What would have made it a better visit?

sampleCallFlow.speaker: caller
sampleCallFlow.text: We waited forty minutes past our time and nobody told us why.

sampleCallFlow.speaker: agent
sampleCallFlow.text: I'm sorry about that wait. I've recorded your comment. Would you like our practice manager to call you about it?

sampleCallFlow.speaker: agent
sampleCallFlow.text: I'll pass it on with your number from this call. Thanks for your time, Maya.

featuresUsed.howItHelps: A CSV of recent customers drives the campaign and each row's columns personalise the call.
Ratings, comments and follow-up requests are saved as named fields so results can be compared.
A dissatisfied customer can be offered an immediate connection to a manager.
A window with a time zone, allowed days and hours limits when the batch is allowed to dial.
Each call produces a summary, and a flat-format webhook can post results to tools like HighLevel, Zapier or Make.
The agent can hang up on voicemail or leave a short message with a callback number.

considerations: Calls made with an automated or artificial voice can need prior consent under rules such as the US TCPA and state laws, including for non-sales calls. Confirm with counsel what consent you hold from your customers.
Honor opt-outs and keep a suppression list. A customer who asks not to be called again should not be in the next batch.
Keep the call short and say so. If calls may be recorded, tell the person at the start and check the consent rules for each region you call.

faq.q: Can I send different customers different details?
faq.a: Yes. Any CSV column other than the phone number becomes a variable for that row's call, such as first_name or service_date.
They appear as extracted fields and a summary on each call in the dashboard and API, and webhooks can send them to your own systems.

faq.q: Can it do a net promoter style question?
faq.a: It can ask any question you write and capture the answer in a field. How you calculate a score from the results is up to your reporting.

faq.q: What if the customer is upset?
faq.a: Write a branch for low ratings that offers a transfer or a callback, and make sure someone is ready to answer that number.
No. Many calls go to voicemail or are not answered, and the outcome is logged. Treat results as the views of people who chose to talk, not of all customers.
